ja: シートベルトのサインが点いているのはわかっているんですが、気分が悪いので、トイレに行ってもいいですか？
en: I know the seatbelt sign is on, but I'm feeling sick, so would it be okay if I used the restroom?
alternatives: I know the seatbelt sign is on, but I feel sick, so could I use the restroom?
I realize the seatbelt sign is on, but I'm feeling sick, so would it be all right if I went to the restroom?
point: would it be okay if の後は過去形 used にする

ja: ノートパソコンを出して、このトレーに入れてください。
en: Please take your laptop out and put it in this tray.
alternatives: Please take out your laptop and put it in this tray.
Take your laptop out and put it in this tray, please.
point: 命令文は動詞の原形から。put it in の it を忘れない

ja: ご迷惑でなければ、通路側の席に替えていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if you could possibly move me to an aisle seat, if it's not too much trouble.
alternatives: If it's no trouble, I was hoping you might be able to switch me to an aisle seat.
Would it be at all possible to move me to an aisle seat, if it's not too much trouble?
point: I was wondering if you could で丁寧に頼む。過去形でも今の依頼

ja: 薬を飲みたいので、お水を一杯いただけますか？
en: Could I have a glass of water to take my medicine with, please?
alternatives: Could I get a glass of water, please? I need to take my medicine.
May I have a glass of water so I can take my medicine?
point: 「薬を飲むための水」は water to take my medicine with

ja: 入国審査官に、帰りの航空券を見せる必要があるって言われたんだ。
en: The immigration officer told me I needed to show my return ticket.
alternatives: The immigration officer said I needed to show my return ticket.
The immigration officer told me I had to show my return ticket.
point: told に合わせて need も needed と過去形にする

ja: すみません、この税関申告書に何を書けばいいか教えてもらえますか？
en: Excuse me, could you tell me what I should write on this customs form?
alternatives: Excuse me, could you tell me what I need to write on this customs form?
Excuse me, can you tell me what to write on this customs declaration form?
point: 文中の疑問は what I should の語順。should I にしない

ja: 彼、もう少し英語が話せたら、入国審査でこんなに時間かからないだろうにね。
en: If he could speak a bit more English, he wouldn't be taking so long at immigration.
alternatives: If he spoke a little more English, he wouldn't be taking this long at immigration.
If his English were a bit better, it wouldn't be taking him so long at immigration.
point: 今の事実に反する仮定は if 節を過去形、主節は wouldn't

ja: すみません、前の座席の下に入れたかばんを上の棚に移したいので、手伝ってもらえますか？
en: Excuse me, could you help me move the bag I put under the seat in front of me into the overhead bin?
alternatives: Excuse me, would you mind helping me move the bag that's under the seat in front of me up to the overhead bin?
Excuse me, could you give me a hand moving the bag I put under the seat in front into the overhead bin?
point: 「入れたかばん」は the bag (that) I put と後ろから説明する

ja: 窓側の席を頼んでおけばよかったな。そうすれば着陸のときに景色が見られたのに。
en: I wish I'd asked for a window seat so I could've seen the view as we came in to land.
alternatives: I should have asked for a window seat so I could have seen the view when we landed.
If only I'd asked for a window seat, I could've enjoyed the view during the landing.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I had 過去分詞。wish I asked は誤り

ja: 保安検査を通ったら、ゲートの近くで何か食べる物を買おうよ。
en: Let's grab something to eat near the gate once we get through security.
alternatives: Once we're through security, let's get something to eat near the gate.
Let's buy something to eat near the gate after we get through security.
point: 「通ったら」は未来でも get と現在形にする

ja: すみません、私の席の下に誰かのかばんがあります。
en: Excuse me, there's someone's bag under my seat.
alternatives: Excuse me, someone's bag is under my seat.
Sorry, there's somebody's bag under my seat.
point: 「〜がある」は There's で始め、場所は文末に置く

ja: 娘の隣に座りたいので、私と席を替わっていただいてもかまいませんか？
en: Would you mind switching seats with me so I can sit next to my daughter?
alternatives: Would you mind trading seats with me so I can sit next to my daughter?
Would you mind changing seats with me so that I can sit beside my daughter?
point: mind の後は動名詞。to switch にしない

ja: 私たちがようやく保安検査を抜けたときには、搭乗口はもう閉まっていました。
en: By the time we finally got through security, the boarding gate had already closed.
alternatives: When we finally cleared security, the boarding gate had already closed.
The gate had already closed by the time we finally got through security.
point: 先に起きた「閉まった」は had closed で過去より前を示す

ja: 隣の席の人が咳をしていたから、私は眠れなかった。
en: I couldn't sleep because the person next to me was coughing.
alternatives: The person next to me was coughing, so I couldn't sleep.
I couldn't sleep because the person beside me was coughing.
point: 続いていた動作は was coughing と過去進行形にする

ja: この国に来るのは初めてではないんですが、前回来たのはもう10年以上前です。
en: This isn't my first time visiting this country, but the last time I came was over ten years ago.
alternatives: I've been to this country before, but the last time I came was more than ten years ago.
It's not my first visit here, but I last came over ten years ago.
point: 前回の訪問は過去の一時点なので現在完了でなく過去形 came

ja: 彼はパスポートを家に忘れてきたに違いない。カウンターでもう10分もかばんの中を探している。
en: He must have left his passport at home. He's been searching his bag at the counter for ten minutes now.
alternatives: He must have left his passport at home. He's been digging through his bag at the counter for ten minutes now.
He must've left his passport at home, because he's been looking through his bag at the counter for ten minutes.
point: 「〜したに違いない」と過去を推量するときは must have + 過去分詞

ja: 乗り継ぎ便を予約してくれた旅行会社には、荷物は最終目的地まで通しで預けられると言われたんですが、合っていますか？
en: The travel agency that booked my connecting flight told me my bag could be checked through to my final destination. Is that right?
alternatives: The travel agency that booked my connecting flight said my bag could be checked all the way to my final destination. Is that correct?
I was told by the travel agency that booked my connection that my bag could go through to my final destination. Is that right?
point: 「〜に言われた」は旅行会社を主語にして told me と能動態で言う

ja: 入国の目的ですか？観光で来ました。
en: I'm here for sightseeing.
alternatives: I'm here on vacation.
I'm here as a tourist.
point: 入国審査では I'm here for 目的 で答える

ja: すみません、10 番ゲートはどこですか？
en: Excuse me, where is Gate 10?
alternatives: Sorry, where is Gate 10?
Excuse me, which way is Gate 10?
point: where の後は is＋主語の語順

ja: お客様、着陸する前にこの入国カードに記入していただけますか？
en: Could you fill out this arrival card before we land, please?
alternatives: Would you mind filling out this arrival card before we land?
Could you please fill in this arrival card before we land?
point: 「記入する」は fill out（fill in も可）で表す

ja: さっき食事はいらないと言ったんですが、それでも飲み物だけいただけますか？
en: Even though I said earlier that I didn't want a meal, could I still get just a drink?
alternatives: I know I said earlier I didn't want a meal, but could I still have just a drink?
Although I said earlier that I didn't need a meal, could I still get something to drink?
point: said に合わせて「いらない」も過去形 didn't want にする

ja: 保安検査で止められた原因は、ノートパソコンじゃなくて、かばんに入れっぱなしにしてた水のボトルだったんだ。
en: It was the water bottle I'd left in my bag, not my laptop, that got me stopped at security.
alternatives: What got me stopped at security wasn't my laptop but the water bottle I'd left in my bag.
It wasn't my laptop that got me stopped at security, it was the water bottle I'd left in my bag.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that で挟む。not ~ は途中に入れる

ja: 保安検査で係員に聞かれたのは、かばんにノートパソコンが入っているかどうかだけでした。
en: All they asked me at security was whether I had a laptop in my bag.
alternatives: The only thing they asked me at security was whether there was a laptop in my bag.
At security, they only asked me if I had a laptop in my bag.
point: 「〜かどうか」は whether か if で名詞節にする

ja: 私たちは出発の2時間前に空港に着かないといけないよ。
en: We have to get to the airport two hours before departure.
alternatives: We need to get to the airport two hours before departure.
We must be at the airport two hours before departure.
point: 「〜しないといけない」は have to。to の後は動詞の原形

ja: 窓側の席に替えてもらえますか？
en: Could you change my seat to a window seat?
alternatives: Can you change my seat to a window seat?
Could you move me to a window seat?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Could you で始める

ja: すみません、私、座席を間違えて座ってしまったかもしれません。搭乗券を確認してもらえますか？
en: Excuse me, I might have taken the wrong seat. Could you check my boarding pass for me?
alternatives: Sorry, I may have sat in the wrong seat. Would you mind checking my boarding pass?
Excuse me, I think I might be in the wrong seat. Could you take a look at my boarding pass?
point: 過去のことの推量は might have + 過去分詞
